comment: Turns the storefront Contact Us page and form on or off.
modal: Controls whether the **Contact Us** page and its `/contact` form are available on the storefront. Set to **No** to remove the page entirely. Can be set per website or store view, so the form can be live on one store and hidden on another.

comment: The email address that receives messages submitted through the Contact Us form.
modal: The inbox that Contact Us submissions are delivered to. Applies only when **Enable Contact Us** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view, so each store can route enquiries to its own team.

comment: Which store email identity the Contact Us notification is sent from.
modal: Selects the sender identity used for the Contact Us notification — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2), configured under *Stores → Configuration → General → Store Email Addresses*. Applies only when **Enable Contact Us** is Yes.
